longmemeval-cleaned.gold: verbatim answer_session_ids; every ID must exist in haystack_session_ids
longmemeval-cleaned.domain_input: verbatim question + exact gold session text under the frozen strict vocabulary

locomo.gold: every nonempty source evidence dia_id must exact-resolve within the same sample
locomo.domain_input: verbatim question + exact gold evidence text under the frozen strict vocabulary

sgd-carryover.gold: nearest earlier USER turn in the same dialogue/service whose source-native span/state exact-supports the carried slot/value

evermembench-dynamic.query: verbatim Q from official qars config
evermembench-dynamic.memories: verbatim dialogue field from official dialogues config; message identity = topic_id/date/group/message_index
evermembench-dynamic.gold: every R entry exact-resolves topic_id/date/group/message_index to a unique source dialogue message

rhelm.gold: every supporting_evidence entry maps mechanically to exactly one pinned source repository path/turn; payload is fetched only at materialization
rhelm.domain: fixed candidate-blind D6/D7 vocabulary over query + answer + supporting_evidence; ties/nonmatches excluded

deduplication.semantic_near_duplicate: audit when computationally feasible; never use Candidate output

formal_language_rule: Runtime natural-language wording remains independently sourced; only preregistered deterministic composition/withholding/distractor transforms are allowed.
